notes.eggaali: Gari, a bicycle; gari mac, “fire bicycle”, is a train.

guidebook.intro: Travel by taxi, bus and boda boda, and say the future with **bi-**.

tips.title: Bi- for will
body: Put **bi-** after the person to talk about the future: **Abiwoto diki** (I will travel tomorrow), **Wabiaa con** (we will leave early), **Gari mac bio cawa adi?** (what time will the train arrive?).

tips.title: Aoo maber
body: **Oo** is to arrive: **Aoo maber** (I have arrived safely), the message every mother waits for. **Wot maber!** (walk well) wishes a good journey.

culture.title: Gulu to Kampala
body: Buses leave Gulu for Kampala many times a day, a journey of about five hours. Ask **Takci man cito kwene?** (where does this taxi go?) before you climb in.
